## HERA — resolve the electron onset before sizing the Landau fan

> **05:24** · Electron onset check: n=+3.2e12 D=0, B 0.20 to 4 T, 635 uniform-1/B points, base T, Si=0 · **ETA ~06:34** (≈1h10m)

`sdh-spot-check` Verify and `landau-fan` step 1 require a measured, adequately sampled onset; run 6 gives censored / background-dependent answers (ana cells 14–15). Repeat n=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D≈0 using the same rounded run-5 calibration as run 6, with uniform 1/B sampling from 0.20 to 4.0 T, 635 points (Δ1/B=0.00749 T⁻¹, Nyquist 66.7 T). This captures the ≈29.4 T tone and its observed ≈58.6 T harmonic, extends below the prior 0.30 T analysis edge, and directly tests grid-dependent aliases. Frequencies above 66.7 T are outside this check's claim; run 6 only tracks those at B>4.8 T, which is excluded. Hole run 7 has a robust onset but its predicted ABAB pair is unresolved even at 10 T, so the electron side remains the useful design route.

Keep τ=0.3 s / 24 dB and the driver's 3 s settle (10τ), drive 1 V / 100 MΩ =10 nA, Si=0, heaters off. Set sr1 to 10 µV (1 kΩ nominal full scale), >8× the measured electron resistance below 4 T; sr0 stays 20 mV. SAFETIES cell 18 [10] exactly matches the card; all validators are re-read before moving. Preconditions verify base temperatures, live logs, magnet/output/PS state, wiring and the handoff zero-field state. No gate pacing or limit is changed.

Price: 4 T / 0.137 T/min =29.2 min total field motion from the handoff; run 6's measured non-ramp overhead is 3.08 s/point (120.36 min minus 73 min bare traverse), hence 635 points ≈32.6 min plus gate setup, extra vaporizer read, and margin. Check first 20 points for current, phases, leakage, rails and field tracking, then every 10 min. Abort on |gate current|>1 nA, loss of current, stale/hot thermometry, or rail approach. Interrupt stops the sweep at a safe point; the VTI supply still completes its last issued field target, so actual field must be re-read after any abort. End at 4 T with gates at the spot; the resulting fan will start there or continue outward, avoiding a blind reset.

    s.fp(p); s.plot(magnet.field,p)
_onset_counter=0
def onset_guard(station,data):
    global _onset_counter
    _onset_counter+=1
    bad=[]
    if not (1.0<=float(data[2])<=1.5 and 0<float(data[3])<1.6): bad.append('temperature')
    if max(abs(float(data[4])),abs(float(data[5])))>1e-9: bad.append('leakage')
    if not 8e-9 < float(data[6])/-1e6 < 12e-9: bad.append('drain current')
    if abs(float(data[8]))>.9*10e-6 or abs(float(data[6]))>.9*.02: bad.append('rail approach')
    if _onset_counter%20==0:
        actual_B=magnet.field()
        print('CHECKPOINT B set/read',data[1],actual_B)
        if abs(actual_B-float(data[1]))>.02: bad.append('field mismatch')
        for name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
            try: assert_thermometry_live(name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
            except Exception as exc: bad.append(str(exc))
    if bad:
        print('STOP:',bad); station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(onset_guard,())
s.sweep(magnet.field,B_vec,delay=0)
print('END actual B,Tg,Bg,Ts,Tv:',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt(),T_sample(),T_vaporizer())
